title: token-launch-prep input
description: What to deploy. There is no key field, and a property that looks like one is refused: the output is an unsigned transaction you sign in your own wallet.

chain.description: The chain the token is deployed on. Default base. The run's RPC must answer this chain's id.

name.description: Token name. 1-64 characters, no leading or trailing space, no control characters.

symbol.description: Token symbol. 1-16 ASCII letters, digits, '$', '.', '_' or '-'.

creator.description: Your address. It becomes the token admin and the only reward recipient (and that recipient's admin), with all 10000 bps.

sender.description: The address that will sign the transaction; the simulation runs as this sender. Default: creator.

image.description: Optional image URL (https:// or ipfs://), stored on the token as written. Default empty.

description.description: Optional description, stored in the token's metadata as {"description": ...}.

interface_name.description: The `interface` written into the token's context string. Default token-launch-prep.

salt.description: CREATE2 salt (bytes32). Default all zeros, as in clanker-sdk. The same name, symbol, admin, image, metadata, context and salt cannot be deployed twice.

pool_preset.description: Initial liquidity positions, ticks as in clanker-sdk POOL_POSITIONS: standard (one position, ticks -230400 to -120000) or project (five positions). Default standard. Both start at tick -230400 with tick spacing 200, paired with WETH.

fees.description: Static pool fee in bps on each side. Default 100 and 100 (1%). Capped at 2000 bps each, as in clanker-sdk.

reward_token.description: Which side of the pool fees the creator's reward position takes: Both, Paired (WETH) or Clanker (the new token). Default Both.
